title: Surgical Video Generation From Diffusion to World Models: A Survey
comment: 4 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Perception and Pattern Recognition (IPPR 2026)
summary: Surgical video data provides the primary training resource for models of intraoperative perception, surgical workflow understanding, and robotic decision-making. However, clinical data acquisition remains constrained by privacy, cost, and class imbalance. Surgical video generation has emerged as a transformative approach to addressing data scarcity and as a foundation for surgical simulation, training, and robotic policy learning. The field has developed rapidly without a clear conceptual framework. This survey organizes the 2024-2026 literature into three categories: unconditional generation, conditional generation, and world modeling generation, revealing a fundamental shift in how the task is defined from synthesizing visually plausible frames to modeling the causal dynamics of surgical scenes. We examine the persistent gap between pixel-level fidelity and clinical plausibility, and identify generalization, physical realism, controllability, and interpretability as bottlenecks. We further summarize experimental results of representative methods on public datasets to provide a quantitative reference for the field. This survey provides a structured overview of the current state and open challenges, offering a reference for researchers working at the intersection of intelligent perception, multi-modal fusion, generative AI, and surgical data science.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2024–2026年手术视频生成领域的研究进展，将其分为无条件生成、条件生成和世界建模生成三类，并指出该领域正从视觉逼真向因果动态建模转变，同时识别出泛化性、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性等关键瓶颈。

title: Procedura: Agentic 3D Modeling with Procedural Control
summary: Native 3D generators now recover impressive mesh geometry from a single image. However, a dense mesh stays soft where a machined object should be sharp, it carries no part decomposition, and it exposes no parameter a user could edit. To address this, we explore the paradigm of 3D shape as code, leveraging and scaling the coding ability of an LLM for 3D modeling. We introduce Procedura, a novel 3D modeling agent framework that writes an object as a procedural assembly, a parametric program whose named parts are joined by typed, machine-checkable mates. From a text prompt, the agent plans the object as an assembly graph and writes the program part by part, solving each placement from the mated frames rather than guessing it, and admitting a part only once compile, mate, and connectivity checks pass. A decoupled vision critic then refines the assembly one diagnosed fix at a time. Moreover, the same graph carries per-part materials and a simulator-validated articulation. We evaluate on P3D-Bench under its assembly judge, and with the same judge on MechBench-36, our hard-surface benchmark. On both, Procedura outperforms state-of-the-art native 3D generators and every prior 3D-code agent on judged quality, produces the sharpest edges of any method we evaluate, and is the only one whose output is an editable, part-structured program.

title: Modality Maturity Index: A benchmark for assessing multimodal capabilities of omni models
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Code and dataset available
summary: Frontier language models are increasingly marketed as omni systems that can perceive and respond across modalities. Existing evaluation frameworks, however, focus almost exclusively on bimodal understanding, typically text plus one other modality. We propose the Modality Maturity Index (MMI), a benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal capabilities of large language models across five modalities (text, image, audio, video and document) and combinations of up to three modalities in both inputs and outputs. MMI consists of 893 questions, each carefully crafted to require the model to demonstrate its understanding of multiple input modalities and to generate responses that incorporate various output formats. The questions are designed to be self-contained, with clear expectations for the correct modality or mix of modalities required for an accurate response. Every MMI prompt carries human-authored rubric criteria for each output modality expected in the response; a model's MMI Value expresses the average of the per-modality scores for each prompt. Because low scores can reflect either failure to generate a modality (lack of presence) or failure to generate correct content, we introduce also a supplementary Modality Presence Score (MPS), a per-prompt F1 over the expected output modalities. Applying MMI to five frontier multimodal models, we find that the MPS ranges from only 15.6 (Claude Opus 4.6) to 34.9 (GPT-5.4). Given the low availability of returned modalities to even grade, we report MPS as our main result pending model improvements. To assess the viability of judging output correctness with LLM judges and rubrics, we run a separate experiment with custom generation tools. On the assets that generates, we find that an LLM judge applying the rubrics agrees with rubric-blind human annotators (who score the outputs directly and never see the criteria) on 70.8% of judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多模态成熟度指数（MMI），用于评估大语言模型在文本、图像、音频、视频和文档五种模态及其最多三模态组合下的输入输出能力。MMI包含893个精心设计的问题，每个问题都配有针对各输出模态的人工评分标准，并引入了补充指标MPS衡量模型生成所需模态的能力。对五个前沿多模态模型的评估显示其MPS得分普遍较低（15.6–34.9），表明当前模型在多模态输出存在性方面仍有很大不足。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架主要关注双模态理解（通常是文本加一种其他模态），无法全面评估前沿语言模型所宣称的跨多模态感知与响应能力。因此，需要一个更全面的基准来衡量模型在多种模态及其组合上的真实表现。
AI.method: 作者提出了Modality Maturity Index（MMI）基准，涵盖五种模态（文本、图像、音频、视频、文档）及最多三模态组合的输入输出。MMI包含893个自包含问题，每个问题均配有针对预期输出模态的人工评分标准。通过计算每个提示下各模态得分的平均值得到MMI Value，并额外引入Modality Presence Score（MPS）来衡量模型是否成功生成了预期模态（基于F1分数）。此外，还通过实验验证了使用LLM裁判结合评分标准判断输出正确性的可行性。
AI.result: 对五个前沿多模态模型的评估显示，其Modality Presence Score（MPS）范围仅为15.6（Claude Opus 4.6）至34.9（GPT-5.4），说明这些模型在实际生成所需多模态输出方面表现不佳。由于多数情况下模型未能返回足够模态以供评分，作者将MPS作为主要结果报告。另外，在模型确实生成输出的情况下，使用LLM裁判依据评分标准进行评判，与未见过评分标准的人类标注者在70.8%的判断上达成一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿多模态大语言模型在多模态输出的存在性和正确性方面仍存在显著不足，尤其在同时处理多种模态输入并生成对应多模态输出的任务中表现有限。MMI提供了一个系统性评估框架，未来可随着模型能力提升进一步用于衡量多模态理解与生成的成熟度。
AI.summary_cn: 前沿语言模型越来越多地被宣传为能够跨模态感知和响应的全能系统。然而，现有的评估框架几乎完全集中在双模态理解上，通常是文本加上另一种模态。我们提出了“模态成熟度指数”（Modality Maturity Index, MMI），这是一个旨在评估大语言模型在五种模态（文本、图像、音频、视频和文档）以及输入和输出中最多三种模态组合下的多模态能力的基准测试。MMI包含893个问题，每个问题都经过精心设计，要求模型展示对多种输入模态的理解，并生成包含多种输出格式的响应。这些问题都是自包含的，对准确回答所需的模态或模态组合有明确期望。每个MMI提示都附带针对响应中预期各输出模态的人工编写的评分标准；模型的MMI值表示每个提示下各模态得分的平均值。由于低分可能反映模型未能生成某模态（缺乏存在性）或生成内容不正确，我们还引入了一个补充指标——模态存在性得分（Modality Presence Score, MPS），即每个提示下对预期输出模态的F1分数。我们将MMI应用于五个前沿多模态模型，发现其MPS得分仅在15.6（Claude Opus 4.6）到34.9（GPT-5.4）之间。鉴于模型返回所需模态的比例过低，以至于难以进行有效评分，我们在模型能力提升之前将MPS作为主要结果报告。为了评估使用大语言模型（LLM）裁判结合评分标准判断输出正确性的可行性，我们还进行了另一项实验，使用定制生成工具。在模型实际生成的输出上，应用评分标准的LLM裁判与未见过评分标准的人类标注者（直接对输出打分且从未看到评分细则）在70.8%的判断上达成一致。

title: Finding the Right Evidence: Factor-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Reasoning for Long Videos
summary: While LVLMs rapidly improve, long-video question answering still remains challenging: relevant evidence is sparse, and question-relevant context often fails to provide cues that discriminate the correct answer from plausible alternatives. Diagnostic analysis on a manually annotated subset of MMR-V shows that prior agentic systems substantially improve cue retrieval over direct VLM inference yet fail to achieve a corresponding gain in answer accuracy, indicating that the bottleneck lies in option-discriminative evidence rather than topical relevance alone. We propose PACE (Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence), a factor-guided framework for long-video evidence acquisition. PACE proceeds in two stages: it first indexes clip-level descriptions guided by question-derived factors without observing the candidate answers; it then uses the candidate answers to derive contrastive cues and queries the index for verification. On MMR-V with the open-source Qwen3-VL backbone, PACE achieves 42.6% accuracy, outperforming direct inference and prior agentic baselines including Deep Video Discovery (DVD). On the same diagnostic subset, PACE recovers 66.9% of the annotated cues, providing empirical evidence that its gains are associated with improved evidence recovery rather than stronger answer-side priors alone. Consistent gains over DVD on LVBench, Video-MME, EgoSchema, and LongVideoBench suggest that option-aware evidence acquisition transfers beyond MMR-V. Code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/PACE.

AI.tldr: PACE 是一种用于长视频问答的两阶段证据获取框架，通过先基于问题因子索引片段描述、再利用候选答案生成对比线索进行验证，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中相关证据稀疏，且现有方法虽能检索到主题相关的上下文，却难以获取足以区分正确答案与干扰项的判别性证据。
AI.method: 提出 PACE（Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence）框架：第一阶段根据问题导出的因子对视频片段描述建立索引（不看选项）；第二阶段利用候选答案生成对比线索，并查询索引以验证答案。
AI.result: 在 MMR-V 上使用 Qwen3-VL 达到 42.6% 准确率，优于直接推理和包括 DVD 在内的现有智能体方法；在人工标注子集上恢复了 66.9% 的标注线索；在 LVBench、Video-MME、EgoSchema 和 LongVideoBench 上也一致优于 DVD。
AI.conclusion: PACE 通过选项感知的证据获取机制有效提升了判别性证据的召回，其性能提升源于更优的证据恢复能力，而非仅依赖更强的答案先验，且该方法具有良好的泛化性。
AI.summary_cn: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）迅速发展，长视频问答仍然具有挑战性：相关证据稀疏，且与问题相关的上下文往往无法提供足以将正确答案与看似合理的干扰项区分开来的线索。在 MMR-V 数据集的人工标注子集上的诊断分析表明，现有的智能体系统虽然在线索检索方面显著优于直接使用视觉语言模型（VLM）推理，但在答案准确率上并未获得相应提升，说明瓶颈在于缺乏选项判别性证据，而不仅仅是主题相关性不足。为此，我们提出了 PACE（Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence），一种由因子引导的长视频证据获取框架。PACE 分两个阶段进行：首先，在不观察候选答案的情况下，根据从问题导出的因子对片段级描述建立索引；然后，利用候选答案生成对比线索，并查询该索引以验证答案。在使用开源 Qwen3-VL 作为主干模型的 MMR-V 数据集上，PACE 达到了 42.6% 的准确率，优于直接推理以及包括 Deep Video Discovery（DVD）在内的先前智能体基线方法。在同一诊断子集上，PACE 恢复了 66.9% 的人工标注线索，提供了实证证据表明其性能提升源于更有效的证据恢复，而非仅仅依赖更强的答案侧先验。在 LVBench、Video-MME、EgoSchema 和 LongVideoBench 上相对于 DVD 的一致提升表明，这种考虑选项的证据获取方法能够泛化到 MMR-V 之外的数据集。代码已开源：https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/PACE。

title: A Unified Framework for the Mechanics of Information in Convolutional Neural Network Image Space
summary:
This paper introduces a unified mathematical framework for modeling information propagation through convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with the aim of connecting descriptions of physical space and information space.
  A correspondence is presented linking discrete filter symmetry and the relativistic energy--momentum relation under the widely used nonlinear rectified convolution operation. Specifically, symmetric filter components (e.g. the sum $Σ= [1,1]$) operate analogously to rest energy $mc^2$ in preserving the image centre of mass (e.g. isotropic diffusion), whereas antisymmetric components (e.g. the gradient $\nabla = [-1,1]$) operate analogously to the momentum term $pc$ in generally inducing a displacement (e.g. vibration or translation). For typical small discrete filters, this displacement is determined by the ratio of antisymmetric to total filter energy, analogously to how the displacement of a relativistic particle relates to a Lorentz transform with beta parameter $β= \frac{v}{c}=\frac{pc}{E}$ equal to the ratio of momentum $pc$ to total energy $E$.
  Repeated filtering leads to the Gaussian scale-space and emergent scale-invariant features. These constructions share a Laplacian-driven structure with the classical heat (diffusion) equation and, via standard mathematical correspondences, with the Schrödinger equation and aspects of the Friedmann equations, together with emergent Morse topological structure. Demonstrations in 3D images reveal blob-like, scale-invariant Morse critical points in images spanning a wide range of physical scales, including organic sugar molecules and inorganic silicon crystals, human and primate brains in magnetic resonance images (MRI), galaxies and the cosmic microwave background (CMB).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的数学框架，将CNN中的信息传播与物理空间和信息空间联系起来，揭示卷积滤波器对称性与相对论能量-动量关系之间的类比，并展示了多尺度图像中涌现的尺度不变特征。
AI.motivation: 连接卷积神经网络中信息传播的描述与物理空间的数学结构，探索滤波操作与物理定律（如相对论、扩散方程、薛定谔方程等）之间的深层联系。
AI.method: 通过分析离散卷积滤波器的对称性（对称分量类比重能 $mc^2$，反对称分量类比动量 $pc$），建立其与相对论能量-动量关系的对应；利用重复滤波导出高斯尺度空间，并关联拉普拉斯驱动的经典热方程、薛定谔方程及弗里德曼方程，结合莫尔斯理论分析拓扑结构。
AI.result: 在多种3D图像（从分子、晶体到大脑MRI、星系和宇宙微波背景）中识别出具有尺度不变性的莫尔斯临界点（blob-like结构），验证了该框架的普适性。
AI.conclusion: CNN中的卷积操作可被理解为一种信息空间中的“物理过程”，其数学结构与多个经典物理理论相通，为理解深度学习中的表征形成提供了新的视角。
AI.summary_cn: 本文提出了一种统一的数学框架，用于建模卷积神经网络（CNN）中的信息传播，旨在连接物理空间与信息空间的描述。文中建立了离散滤波器对称性与相对论能量—动量关系之间的对应关系，该对应关系适用于广泛使用的非线性整流卷积操作。具体而言，对称滤波器分量（例如求和算子 Σ = [1,1]）类似于静止能量 mc²，在保持图像质心方面起作用（例如各向同性扩散）；而反对称分量（例如梯度算子 ∇ = [-1,1]）则类似于动量项 pc，通常会引起位移（例如振动或平移）。对于典型的小型离散滤波器，这种位移由反对称分量能量与总滤波器能量之比决定，这类似于相对论粒子的位移由洛伦兹变换中的 β 参数（β = v/c = pc/E）所决定，即动量 pc 与总能量 E 的比值。重复滤波操作可导出高斯尺度空间及涌现的尺度不变特征。这些构造与经典热（扩散）方程具有拉普拉斯驱动的共同结构，并通过标准数学对应关系，进一步关联到薛定谔方程和弗里德曼方程的部分形式，同时展现出莫尔斯拓扑结构。在三维图像中的实证研究表明，从有机糖分子、无机硅晶体，到人类与灵长类动物的磁共振成像（MRI）大脑图像，乃至星系和宇宙微波背景（CMB），均存在类似斑点状、尺度不变的莫尔斯临界点。

title: VIPER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Veterinary Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models are advancing rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain focused on human tissue, particularly oncology, leaving non-human pathology largely unaddressed. This gap is especially important in toxicologic pathology, where microscopic tissue examination of laboratory animals is a core component of preclinical drug safety assessment. To address it, we introduce VIPER, the first expert-curated benchmark for vision-language model evaluation in toxicologic pathology. VIPER contains 1,251 questions associated with 419 H&E-stained rat histology images across seven organ systems, covering multiple-choice, KPrim, and free-text formats. All questions were curated and validated by board-certified veterinary pathologists. In total, we benchmarked 16 models, including two newly introduced veterinary-pathology models, seven human pathology-specialized models, and seven general-purpose frontier models. The results identify a substantial domain gap between veterinary and human pathology, expose the risk of over-diagnosis of normal tissue in frontier models, and show that domain-specific training remains critical for visually grounded predictions. VIPER data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/viper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VIPER，首个针对毒理病理学的视觉-语言模型评测基准，涵盖大鼠组织切片图像与专家验证的问题，揭示了通用及人类病理模型在兽医病理领域的性能差距，并强调领域特定训练的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有病理视觉-语言模型的评测基准主要集中于人类组织（尤其是肿瘤学），忽视了非人类病理，特别是在依赖实验动物组织显微检查的毒理病理学领域，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 构建VIPER基准：包含419张H&E染色大鼠组织图像、1,251个由认证兽医病理学家审核的问题，覆盖7个器官系统和多种问题类型；评测16个模型，包括新提出的兽医病理专用模型、人类病理专用模型及通用前沿模型。
AI.result: 评测结果显示兽医与人类病理之间存在显著领域差距；前沿模型存在对正常组织过度诊断的风险；领域特定训练对实现准确的视觉-语言推理至关重要。
AI.conclusion: VIPER为毒理病理学中的视觉-语言模型评估提供了首个专业基准，突显了跨物种病理理解的挑战，并强调开发专用模型的必要性。
AI.summary_cn: 病理视觉-语言模型正在迅速发展，但现有的评测基准仍集中于人类组织，尤其是肿瘤学领域，而对非人类病理关注甚少。这一空白在毒理病理学中尤为关键，因为实验动物的显微组织检查是临床前药物安全性评估的核心环节。为解决此问题，我们提出了VIPER——首个由专家策划的毒理病理学视觉-语言模型评测基准。VIPER包含419张H&E染色的大鼠组织学图像，涵盖七个器官系统，共关联1,251个问题，题型包括多项选择题、KPrim题和自由文本题。所有问题均由委员会认证的兽医病理学家策划并验证。我们总共评测了16个模型，包括两个新提出的兽医病理专用模型、七个人类病理专用模型以及七个通用前沿模型。结果表明，兽医病理与人类病理之间存在显著的领域差距，前沿模型存在对正常组织过度诊断的风险，并且领域特定训练对于实现基于视觉的准确预测仍然至关重要。VIPER数据集与评测代码已开源：https://github.com/mahmoodlab/viper。

title: Mapping Woody Vegetation from Multi-Source Imagery and Prediction Fusion for Enhanced Data Efficiency and Accuracy
comment: Published in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Tree cover maps are a fundamental remote sensing product, used to derive ecological insights about the landscape and are essential to change detection, vegetation mapping and fire monitoring programs. However, comprehensive tree cover mapping requires reliable and high-quality imagery, free of cloud and weather defects to ensure accurate model outputs. Deep learning approaches can generate high quality maps with minimal human intervention but require large amounts of human annotated data to be successful. In this work we propose a framework consisting of methods that aim to improve the data efficiency and robustness of deep learning models using data fusion techniques to segment woody vegetation defined as vegetation over the height of 2m across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To improve robustness against varying image quality, we propose an image composition method that normalizes the imagery and removes defects, whilst also minimizing the reliance on individual image quality by proposing a prediction fusion method. The two methods resulted in an error reduction of 38.2% and 53.6% respectively compared to single-source imagery. To address deep learning approaches' limitation of requiring large amounts of data, we apply label transfer to multiple sources of imagery as a form of data augmentation to improve data efficiency. Learning from multiple image sources was shown to be the biggest improvement in performance, resulting in an error reduction between 28.1% to 76.2% across the different validation experiments, whilst reducing the standard deviation of performance across image dates by a factor of 13.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合图像融合与标签迁移的数据高效深度学习框架，用于澳大利亚新南威尔士州高精度树木覆盖制图，在减少对高质量单源影像依赖的同时显著提升模型鲁棒性与性能。
AI.motivation: 全面的树木覆盖制图需要无云无天气干扰的高质量遥感影像，而深度学习虽能自动生成高精度地图，却严重依赖大量人工标注数据；因此亟需提升模型在数据效率和图像质量变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出包含图像合成（归一化并去除缺陷）和预测融合的方法以增强对图像质量变化的鲁棒性，并利用标签迁移将标注信息扩展至多源影像，实现数据增强与高效学习。
AI.result: 图像合成和预测融合分别将误差降低38.2%和53.6%；多源影像学习带来最大性能提升，误差降低28.1%–76.2%，且跨时间性能标准差降低13倍。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架通过数据融合与标签迁移显著提升了深度学习在树木覆盖制图中的数据效率和鲁棒性，减少了对单一高质量影像和大量标注数据的依赖。
AI.summary_cn: 树冠覆盖图是一种基础的遥感产品，可用于获取关于景观的生态学见解，并对变化检测、植被制图和火灾监测项目至关重要。然而，全面的树冠覆盖制图需要可靠且高质量的影像，且必须无云和天气干扰，以确保模型输出的准确性。深度学习方法能够在极少人工干预的情况下生成高质量地图，但其成功依赖于大量人工标注数据。本研究提出一个框架，结合多种方法，利用数据融合技术对澳大利亚新南威尔士州范围内高度超过2米的木本植被进行分割，旨在提高深度学习模型的数据效率和鲁棒性。为增强模型对不同影像质量的鲁棒性，我们提出一种图像合成方法，可对影像进行归一化并去除缺陷，同时通过预测融合方法降低对单张影像质量的依赖。这两种方法相较于单源影像分别将误差降低了38.2%和53.6%。为解决深度学习对大量标注数据的依赖问题，我们将标签迁移应用于多源影像，作为一种数据增强手段以提升数据效率。实验表明，利用多源影像进行学习带来了最大的性能提升，在不同验证实验中误差降低了28.1%至76.2%，同时将不同成像日期下模型性能的标准差降低了13倍。

title: Zero-Shot Video Restoration and Enhancement with Text-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models and Multi-Modal References
summary: Zero-shot image restoration methods with text-to-image latent diffusion models have achieved great success in universal image restoration tasks without training. However, applying them to video restoration will result in severe temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for zero-shot video restoration and enhancement which uses a text-to-image latent diffusion model and multi-modal references. Through the proposed dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling, the inference time can be reduced to nearly 1/3 of the original. The performance and temporal consistency can be also significantly stregthened. By using the proposed texture-aware video token merging, the temporal correlation between frames can be further utilized to improve the temporal consistency. We futher propose the referenced self-attention and referenced token merging to support image reference. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in restoring and enhancing temporally consistent videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的零样本视频修复与增强框架，通过双提示调谐、纹理感知帧间token融合及参考自注意力机制，在显著减少推理时间的同时提升视频的时间一致性与修复质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本图像修复方法在视频任务中会产生严重的时间闪烁问题，缺乏时间一致性，因此需要专门针对视频设计新的零样本修复方案。
AI.method: 提出一种结合文本到图像潜在扩散模型与多模态参考的零样本视频修复框架，包括双提示调谐反演与采样、纹理感知视频token融合、参考自注意力机制和参考token融合。
AI.result: 推理时间降至原来的约1/3，同时显著提升了视频修复效果和帧间时间一致性；实验验证了该方法在多种视频修复与增强任务中的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法有效解决了零样本视频修复中的时间闪烁问题，在不需额外训练的前提下实现了高质量且时间一致的视频修复与增强。
AI.summary_cn: 基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本图像修复方法在无需训练的情况下已在通用图像修复任务中取得巨大成功。然而，将其应用于视频修复会导致严重的时间闪烁问题。本文提出了一种新颖的零样本视频修复与增强框架，该框架利用文本到图像潜在扩散模型和多模态参考信息。通过所提出的双提示调谐反演与采样策略，推理时间可减少至原来的约三分之一，同时显著增强了性能和时间一致性。借助所提出的纹理感知视频token融合方法，可进一步利用帧间的时间相关性以提升时间一致性。我们还提出了参考自注意力机制和参考token融合方法以支持图像参考。实验结果表明，所提方法在恢复和增强时间一致的视频方面具有明显优势。

title: Learning Woody Clearing With Loss Alignment for Zero-Shot Regrowth and Woody Segmentation
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Detecting woody clearing is vital for managing biodiversity. Deep learning models can detect change in woody vegetation from bitemporal remote sensing imagery, however generated products may not meet end-user specifications due to unaligned loss definitions. Further limitations of deep learning models are the reliance on large datasets which can be difficult to attain for spatially rare and ambiguous events such as regrowth detection. In this work we train a model to detect woody change using bitemporal Sentinel-2 imagery consisting of 7 years' worth of annual imagery across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To align the objective of the model with end-user metrics, we introduce the loss scaling coefficient $α$ which transforms the objective to optimize for specific $F_β$ scores. Introducing $α$ was found to increase precision by 1.85x or recall by 1.12x. We propose input imagery augmentation and generation techniques that allow the woody change detection model to zero-shot transfer to regrowth and woody segmentation tasks. For woody segmentation, image generation techniques using activation maximization with low $α$ values for stability and image generation techniques derived from handcrafted features utilizing a mosaic of clearing patches and artificial trees for contextual grounding were found to outperform prior woody segmentation works of the study area, reducing the overall error by up to 18.2%. For zero-shot woody regrowth, creating pseudo-post and prior images resulted in the model achieving an F1 score of 0.845, creating a foundation for future regrowth detection work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合可调损失系数α和图像生成增强策略的深度学习方法，用于从Sentinel-2双时相影像中检测林地变化，并成功实现对再生林和林地分割任务的零样本迁移，在多个指标上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在林地清除检测中存在两个主要问题：一是模型优化目标（损失函数）与终端用户关注的评估指标（如Fβ分数）不一致；二是缺乏适用于空间稀疏且模糊事件（如林地再生）的大规模标注数据集。
AI.method: 作者使用澳大利亚新南威尔士州7年Sentinel-2年度影像训练林地变化检测模型，并引入损失缩放系数α以直接优化特定Fβ分数。此外，提出基于激活最大化和手工特征的图像增强与生成技术，使模型能零样本迁移到再生林检测和林地分割任务。
AI.result: 引入α系数使模型精度提升1.85倍或召回率提升1.12倍；在林地分割任务中，所提图像生成方法将总体误差降低最多18.2%；在零样本再生林检测中，模型F1分数达0.845。
AI.conclusion: 通过调整损失函数与用户指标对齐，并结合创新的图像生成策略，该方法有效提升了林地变化检测性能，并为稀有生态事件（如再生）的零样本检测提供了可行路径。
AI.summary_cn: 检测林地清除对于生物多样性管理至关重要。深度学习模型可利用双时相遥感影像检测木本植被变化，但由于损失函数定义与终端用户需求不一致，其生成产品可能无法满足实际应用要求。此外，深度学习模型通常依赖大规模数据集，而像再生林检测这类空间稀疏且模糊的事件往往难以获得足够标注数据。本研究利用澳大利亚新南威尔士州为期7年的年度Sentinel-2双时相影像训练林地变化检测模型。为使模型目标与用户评估指标对齐，我们引入损失缩放系数α，将优化目标直接转化为特定Fβ分数。实验表明，引入α可使精度提升1.85倍或召回率提升1.12倍。我们还提出了输入影像增强与生成技术，使林地变化检测模型能够零样本迁移到再生林检测和林地分割任务。在林地分割方面，采用低α值的激活最大化图像生成方法以保证稳定性，以及基于手工特征、结合清除斑块镶嵌图和人工树木以提供上下文信息的图像生成方法，均优于该研究区域先前的工作，总体误差最多降低18.2%。在零样本林地再生检测中，通过构建伪“后时相”和“前时相”影像，模型取得了0.845的F1分数，为未来的再生林检测研究奠定了基础。

title: Video-FLAIR: Not Whether to Reason, But How
summary: Multimodal queries can require different types of reasoning. Some can be answered via perceptual reasoning, extracting information directly from the visual signal, while others require compositional reasoning that combines observations or deliberative reasoning that evaluates competing hypotheses. However, many existing methods apply a uniform reasoning strategy across queries, leading to unnecessary computation on simple tasks and insufficient reasoning on complex ones. We introduce Video-FLAIR, a training framework that learns to select the appropriate reasoning mode for each query using reinforcement learning. During training, the model generates responses under all three modes for the same prompt, enabling direct comparison. A composite reward compares these responses to favor the most effective one based on correctness, grounding, and cost, while discouraging unsupported or misaligned deliberation. This yields a supervision signal for learning adaptive reasoning without per-query annotations. Video-FLAIR improves accuracy over the Qwen2.5-VL base model by +5.4 on MathVista, +4.8 on Video-Holmes, and +4.8 on Video-MMMU, while reducing average token usage to 95 compared to 417 for always-thinking baselines.

AI.tldr: Video-FLAIR is a reinforcement learning–based training framework that enables multimodal models to adaptively select among perceptual, compositional, or deliberative reasoning modes per query, improving accuracy and reducing token usage without requiring per-query annotations.
AI.motivation: Existing multimodal models often apply a single, uniform reasoning strategy regardless of query complexity—wasting computation on simple tasks and underperforming on complex ones that need deeper reasoning.
AI.method: Video-FLAIR trains a model using reinforcement learning to dynamically choose the best reasoning mode (perceptual, compositional, or deliberative) for each query. During training, all three modes generate responses to the same prompt; a composite reward based on correctness, grounding, and cost guides the selection, enabling adaptive reasoning without explicit labels.
AI.result: Video-FLAIR boosts accuracy over Qwen2.5-VL by +5.4 on MathVista, +4.8 on Video-Holmes, and +4.8 on Video-MMMU, while cutting average token usage from 417 to 95 compared to always-thinking baselines.
AI.conclusion: Adaptive reasoning selection via reinforcement learning significantly enhances both performance and efficiency in multimodal video understanding, eliminating the need for costly per-query reasoning annotations.
AI.summary_cn: 多模态查询可能需要不同类型的推理。有些可以通过感知推理直接从视觉信号中提取信息来回答，而另一些则需要组合推理（结合多个观察结果）或审慎推理（评估相互竞争的假设）。然而，许多现有方法对所有查询采用统一的推理策略，导致在简单任务上计算冗余，在复杂任务上推理不足。我们提出了 Video-FLAIR，这是一种基于强化学习的训练框架，能够为每个查询选择合适的推理模式。在训练过程中，模型针对同一提示在三种推理模式下生成回答，从而实现直接比较。一个复合奖励机制根据正确性、依据性和计算成本对这些回答进行评估，鼓励最有效的推理方式，同时抑制缺乏支持或与任务不一致的审慎推理。这使得模型无需逐查询标注即可学习自适应推理。Video-FLAIR 在 MathVista、Video-Holmes 和 Video-MMMU 上分别比 Qwen2.5-VL 基础模型提升了 +5.4、+4.8 和 +4.8 的准确率，同时将平均 token 使用量从始终推理基线的 417 降至 95。

title: Surgical Video Generation From Diffusion to World Models: A Survey
comment: 4 pages, 1 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 3rd International Conference on Intelligent Perception and Pattern Recognition (IPPR 2026)
summary: Surgical video data provides the primary training resource for models of intraoperative perception, surgical workflow understanding, and robotic decision-making. However, clinical data acquisition remains constrained by privacy, cost, and class imbalance. Surgical video generation has emerged as a transformative approach to addressing data scarcity and as a foundation for surgical simulation, training, and robotic policy learning. The field has developed rapidly without a clear conceptual framework. This survey organizes the 2024-2026 literature into three categories: unconditional generation, conditional generation, and world modeling generation, revealing a fundamental shift in how the task is defined from synthesizing visually plausible frames to modeling the causal dynamics of surgical scenes. We examine the persistent gap between pixel-level fidelity and clinical plausibility, and identify generalization, physical realism, controllability, and interpretability as bottlenecks. We further summarize experimental results of representative methods on public datasets to provide a quantitative reference for the field. This survey provides a structured overview of the current state and open challenges, offering a reference for researchers working at the intersection of intelligent perception, multi-modal fusion, generative AI, and surgical data science.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了2024–2026年间手术视频生成领域的研究进展，将其分为无条件生成、有条件生成和世界建模生成三类，并指出该领域正从视觉逼真转向因果动态建模，同时识别出泛化性、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性等关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 由于临床手术视频数据受限于隐私、成本和类别不平衡等问题，手术视频生成成为缓解数据稀缺、推动手术模拟、培训及机器人策略学习的重要手段；然而该领域缺乏统一的概念框架，亟需系统性梳理。
AI.method: 对2024–2026年相关文献进行分类整理，划分为无条件生成、有条件生成和世界建模生成三类，并分析代表性方法在公开数据集上的实验结果，评估其在像素保真度与临床合理性之间的差距。
AI.result: 揭示了手术视频生成任务的核心转变——从生成视觉上合理的帧到建模手术场景的因果动态；总结出当前方法在泛化能力、物理真实感、可控性和可解释性方面仍存在显著挑战；提供了定量参考基准。
AI.conclusion: 本综述为智能感知、多模态融合、生成式AI与手术数据科学交叉领域的研究人员提供了结构化的现状概览和开放挑战清单，有助于指导未来研究方向。
AI.summary_cn: 手术视频数据是术中感知模型、手术流程理解以及机器人决策训练的主要资源。然而，临床数据获取仍受限于隐私、成本和类别不平衡等问题。手术视频生成作为一种变革性方法，正在应对数据稀缺问题，并成为手术模拟、培训和机器人策略学习的基础。该领域虽快速发展，却缺乏清晰的概念框架。本综述将2024–2026年的文献划分为三类：无条件生成、有条件生成和世界建模生成，揭示了该任务定义的根本性转变——从合成视觉上可信的图像帧，转向对手术场景因果动态的建模。我们探讨了像素级保真度与临床合理性之间的持续差距，并指出泛化性、物理真实性、可控性和可解释性是当前的关键瓶颈。此外，我们汇总了代表性方法在公开数据集上的实验结果，为该领域提供定量参考。本综述系统梳理了当前研究现状与开放挑战，为从事智能感知、多模态融合、生成式人工智能与手术数据科学交叉研究的学者提供参考。

title: Procedura: Agentic 3D Modeling with Procedural Control
summary: Native 3D generators now recover impressive mesh geometry from a single image. However, a dense mesh stays soft where a machined object should be sharp, it carries no part decomposition, and it exposes no parameter a user could edit. To address this, we explore the paradigm of 3D shape as code, leveraging and scaling the coding ability of an LLM for 3D modeling. We introduce Procedura, a novel 3D modeling agent framework that writes an object as a procedural assembly, a parametric program whose named parts are joined by typed, machine-checkable mates. From a text prompt, the agent plans the object as an assembly graph and writes the program part by part, solving each placement from the mated frames rather than guessing it, and admitting a part only once compile, mate, and connectivity checks pass. A decoupled vision critic then refines the assembly one diagnosed fix at a time. Moreover, the same graph carries per-part materials and a simulator-validated articulation. We evaluate on P3D-Bench under its assembly judge, and with the same judge on MechBench-36, our hard-surface benchmark. On both, Procedura outperforms state-of-the-art native 3D generators and every prior 3D-code agent on judged quality, produces the sharpest edges of any method we evaluate, and is the only one whose output is an editable, part-structured program.

AI.tldr: Procedura 是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的新型 3D 建模智能体框架，将 3D 形状表示为可编辑、参数化的程序化装配体，显著优于现有原生 3D 生成器和先前的 3D-代码方法，在几何锐度、结构合理性和可编辑性方面表现突出。
AI.motivation: 当前的原生 3D 生成器虽然能从单张图像恢复出精细网格，但存在三大缺陷：无法生成机械物体应有的锐利边缘、缺乏部件分解结构、输出不可编辑。为解决这些问题，作者提出将 3D 形状视为代码，利用 LLM 的编程能力进行 3D 建模。
AI.method: 提出 Procedura 框架，该框架将物体表示为程序化装配体——一种参数化程序，其命名部件通过类型化且可机器验证的配合关系（mates）连接。智能体根据文本提示规划装配图，并逐部分编写程序，每个部件的位置由配合坐标系精确求解而非猜测，且只有在编译、配合和连通性检查全部通过后才被接受。随后，一个解耦的视觉评判模块对装配体进行逐项诊断和修正。该装配图还承载了各部件材质和经仿真验证的可动结构。
AI.result: 在 P3D-Bench 和新提出的硬表面基准 MechBench-36 上的评估表明，Procedura 在评审质量上超越了所有现有的原生 3D 生成器和之前的 3D-代码智能体，生成了所评测方法中最锐利的边缘，并且是唯一能输出可编辑、具有部件结构的程序的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将 3D 形状建模为代码是一种有效范式，Procedura 框架成功地结合了 LLM 的规划与编程能力以及严格的几何约束，为生成高质量、结构化且用户可编辑的 3D 模型提供了新途径。
AI.summary_cn: 当前的原生 3D 生成器已能从单张图像中恢复出令人印象深刻的网格几何。然而，生成的稠密网格在本应锐利的机械物体部位却显得过于柔和，缺乏部件分解结构，并且不提供任何可供用户编辑的参数。为解决此问题，我们探索了“3D 形状即代码”的范式，利用并扩展大语言模型（LLM）的编码能力来进行 3D 建模。我们提出了 Procedura，一种新颖的 3D 建模智能体框架，它将物体编写为程序化装配体——一种参数化程序，其命名部件通过类型化且可机器验证的配合关系（mates）进行连接。该智能体根据文本提示，首先将物体规划为一个装配图，然后逐部分编写程序，每个部件的位置均由其配合坐标系精确求解而非猜测，并且只有在编译、配合和连通性检查全部通过后，该部件才会被采纳。随后，一个解耦的视觉评判模块会一次诊断并修正一个装配问题。此外，同一个装配图还承载了各部件的材质信息和经过仿真验证的可动结构。我们在 P3D-Bench 及其装配评审标准下进行了评估，并在同一评审标准下使用我们提出的硬表面基准 MechBench-36 进行了测试。在这两个基准上，Procedura 在评审质量上均优于当前最先进的原生 3D 生成器和所有先前的 3D-代码智能体，生成了我们所评测方法中最锐利的边缘，并且是唯一能够输出可编辑、具有部件结构程序的方法。

title: Modality Maturity Index: A benchmark for assessing multimodal capabilities of omni models
comment: 26 pages, 6 figures. Code and dataset available
summary: Frontier language models are increasingly marketed as omni systems that can perceive and respond across modalities. Existing evaluation frameworks, however, focus almost exclusively on bimodal understanding, typically text plus one other modality. We propose the Modality Maturity Index (MMI), a benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal capabilities of large language models across five modalities (text, image, audio, video and document) and combinations of up to three modalities in both inputs and outputs. MMI consists of 893 questions, each carefully crafted to require the model to demonstrate its understanding of multiple input modalities and to generate responses that incorporate various output formats. The questions are designed to be self-contained, with clear expectations for the correct modality or mix of modalities required for an accurate response. Every MMI prompt carries human-authored rubric criteria for each output modality expected in the response; a model's MMI Value expresses the average of the per-modality scores for each prompt. Because low scores can reflect either failure to generate a modality (lack of presence) or failure to generate correct content, we introduce also a supplementary Modality Presence Score (MPS), a per-prompt F1 over the expected output modalities. Applying MMI to five frontier multimodal models, we find that the MPS ranges from only 15.6 (Claude Opus 4.6) to 34.9 (GPT-5.4). Given the low availability of returned modalities to even grade, we report MPS as our main result pending model improvements. To assess the viability of judging output correctness with LLM judges and rubrics, we run a separate experiment with custom generation tools. On the assets that generates, we find that an LLM judge applying the rubrics agrees with rubric-blind human annotators (who score the outputs directly and never see the criteria) on 70.8% of judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了多模态成熟度指数（MMI），用于评估大语言模型在文本、图像、音频、视频和文档五种模态及其组合上的多模态能力，发现当前前沿模型在输出模态存在性方面表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架主要关注双模态理解（通常是文本加一种其他模态），无法全面衡量前沿语言模型作为“全能系统”在多种模态输入与输出上的综合能力。
AI.method: 构建包含893个问题的MMI基准，每个问题要求模型理解多种输入模态并生成包含多种输出格式的回答；引入MMI值（基于人工评分标准的各模态平均分）和补充指标MPS（模态存在性得分，衡量模型是否生成了预期的输出模态）；并通过LLM裁判与人类标注者对比实验验证评分可行性。
AI.result: 对五个前沿多模态模型的评估显示，其MPS得分仅为15.6（Claude Opus 4.6）至34.9（GPT-5.4）；由于模型返回模态的低可用性，作者以MPS为主要结果；LLM裁判与人类标注者在70.8%的判断上一致。
AI.conclusion: 当前前沿多模态大模型在实际生成多模态输出方面仍存在显著不足，亟需改进；MMI为未来多模态系统评估提供了有效框架。
AI.summary_cn: 前沿语言模型越来越多地被宣传为能够跨模态感知和响应的全能系统。然而，现有的评估框架几乎完全聚焦于双模态理解，通常是文本加上另一种模态。我们提出了多模态成熟度指数（MMI），这是一个旨在评估大语言模型在五种模态（文本、图像、音频、视频和文档）以及输入和输出中最多三种模态组合下的多模态能力的基准测试。MMI包含893个问题，每个问题都经过精心设计，要求模型展示其对多种输入模态的理解，并生成包含各种输出格式的回答。这些问题都是自包含的，对准确回答所需的正确模态或模态组合有明确的期望。每个MMI提示都附带了针对预期输出模态的人工撰写的评分标准；模型的MMI值表示每个提示下各模态得分的平均值。由于低分可能反映未能生成某模态（缺乏存在性）或生成内容不正确，我们还引入了一个补充性的模态存在性得分（MPS），即每个提示下预期输出模态的F1分数。将MMI应用于五个前沿多模态模型后，我们发现MPS得分仅从15.6（Claude Opus 4.6）到34.9（GPT-5.4）。鉴于模型返回模态的可用性很低，以至于难以进行内容正确性评分，我们在模型改进之前以MPS作为主要结果报告。为了评估使用大语言模型裁判和评分标准来判断输出正确性的可行性，我们使用定制生成工具进行了单独实验。在所生成的内容上，应用评分标准的大语言模型裁判与未见过评分标准、直接对输出打分的人类标注者在70.8%的判断上达成一致。

title: Finding the Right Evidence: Factor-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Reasoning for Long Videos
summary: While LVLMs rapidly improve, long-video question answering still remains challenging: relevant evidence is sparse, and question-relevant context often fails to provide cues that discriminate the correct answer from plausible alternatives. Diagnostic analysis on a manually annotated subset of MMR-V shows that prior agentic systems substantially improve cue retrieval over direct VLM inference yet fail to achieve a corresponding gain in answer accuracy, indicating that the bottleneck lies in option-discriminative evidence rather than topical relevance alone. We propose PACE (Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence), a factor-guided framework for long-video evidence acquisition. PACE proceeds in two stages: it first indexes clip-level descriptions guided by question-derived factors without observing the candidate answers; it then uses the candidate answers to derive contrastive cues and queries the index for verification. On MMR-V with the open-source Qwen3-VL backbone, PACE achieves 42.6% accuracy, outperforming direct inference and prior agentic baselines including Deep Video Discovery (DVD). On the same diagnostic subset, PACE recovers 66.9% of the annotated cues, providing empirical evidence that its gains are associated with improved evidence recovery rather than stronger answer-side priors alone. Consistent gains over DVD on LVBench, Video-MME, EgoSchema, and LongVideoBench suggest that option-aware evidence acquisition transfers beyond MMR-V. Code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/PACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE框架，通过两阶段渐进式获取关键证据来提升长视频问答准确率，在MMR-V等数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答方法虽能检索到主题相关的上下文，但缺乏区分正确答案与干扰项的判别性证据，导致准确率受限。
AI.method: 提出PACE（Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence）框架：第一阶段基于问题因子索引片段描述（不看候选答案），第二阶段利用候选答案生成对比线索并查询索引进行验证。
AI.result: 在MMR-V上使用Qwen3-VL达到42.6%准确率，优于直接推理和DVD等基线；在诊断子集上恢复66.9%标注线索，并在多个基准上均取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 选项感知的证据获取机制有效提升了判别性证据的召回，从而提高长视频问答性能，且该方法具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.summary_cn: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）迅速发展，长视频问答仍然具有挑战性：相关证据稀疏，且与问题相关的上下文往往无法提供足够线索以区分正确答案与看似合理的干扰项。在MMR-V数据集的人工标注子集上的诊断分析表明，现有的智能体系统虽然在线索检索方面显著优于直接使用VLM推理，但在答案准确率上并未相应提升，说明瓶颈在于缺乏选项判别性证据，而不仅仅是主题相关性不足。为此，我们提出了PACE（渐进式关键证据获取）框架，这是一种由问题因子引导的长视频证据获取方法。PACE分为两个阶段：首先在不观察候选答案的情况下，根据问题导出的因子对视频片段描述建立索引；然后利用候选答案生成对比线索，并查询该索引来验证答案。在使用开源Qwen3-VL作为主干模型的MMR-V数据集上，PACE取得了42.6%的准确率，优于直接推理和包括Deep Video Discovery（DVD）在内的先前智能体基线方法。在同一诊断子集上，PACE成功恢复了66.9%的人工标注线索，这提供了实证证据，表明其性能提升源于更优的证据恢复能力，而非仅依赖更强的答案侧先验。此外，PACE在LVBench、Video-MME、EgoSchema和LongVideoBench等多个基准上均持续优于DVD，表明这种选项感知的证据获取方法可有效迁移到MMR-V之外的场景。代码已开源：https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/PACE。

title: A Unified Framework for the Mechanics of Information in Convolutional Neural Network Image Space
summary:
This paper introduces a unified mathematical framework for modeling information propagation through convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with the aim of connecting descriptions of physical space and information space.
  A correspondence is presented linking discrete filter symmetry and the relativistic energy--momentum relation under the widely used nonlinear rectified convolution operation. Specifically, symmetric filter components (e.g. the sum $Σ= [1,1]$) operate analogously to rest energy $mc^2$ in preserving the image centre of mass (e.g. isotropic diffusion), whereas antisymmetric components (e.g. the gradient $\nabla = [-1,1]$) operate analogously to the momentum term $pc$ in generally inducing a displacement (e.g. vibration or translation). For typical small discrete filters, this displacement is determined by the ratio of antisymmetric to total filter energy, analogously to how the displacement of a relativistic particle relates to a Lorentz transform with beta parameter $β= \frac{v}{c}=\frac{pc}{E}$ equal to the ratio of momentum $pc$ to total energy $E$.
  Repeated filtering leads to the Gaussian scale-space and emergent scale-invariant features. These constructions share a Laplacian-driven structure with the classical heat (diffusion) equation and, via standard mathematical correspondences, with the Schrödinger equation and aspects of the Friedmann equations, together with emergent Morse topological structure. Demonstrations in 3D images reveal blob-like, scale-invariant Morse critical points in images spanning a wide range of physical scales, including organic sugar molecules and inorganic silicon crystals, human and primate brains in magnetic resonance images (MRI), galaxies and the cosmic microwave background (CMB).

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的数学框架，将CNN中的信息传播与物理空间描述联系起来，揭示卷积滤波器对称性与相对论能量-动量关系之间的类比，并展示其在多尺度图像中产生尺度不变特征的能力。
AI.motivation: 建立卷积神经网络中信息传播过程与物理世界（如相对论、热传导、量子力学和宇宙学）之间深层次的数学联系，以理解CNN如何处理和表征多尺度结构。
AI.method: 通过分析离散卷积滤波器的对称性（对称分量类比静能，反对称分量类比动量），构建与相对论能量-动量关系的对应；结合高斯尺度空间理论、拉普拉斯算子驱动的扩散方程及其与薛定谔方程、弗里德曼方程的数学关联，引入莫尔斯拓扑结构进行分析。
AI.result: 在多种3D图像数据（从分子、晶体到大脑MRI、星系及宇宙微波背景）中识别出具有尺度不变性的莫尔斯临界点（blob-like结构），验证了该框架的普适性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: CNN中的信息传播可通过类物理模型统一描述，其内在机制与多个物理领域的基本方程共享数学结构，从而为理解深度学习中的多尺度表征提供了新的理论视角。
AI.summary_cn: 本文提出一个统一的数学框架，用于建模卷积神经网络（CNN）中的信息传播过程，旨在连接物理空间与信息空间的描述。文中建立了离散滤波器对称性与相对论能量-动量关系之间的对应关系，该关系在广泛使用的非线性整流卷积操作下成立。具体而言，对称滤波器分量（例如求和算子 Σ = [1,1]）类似于静能 mc²，在保持图像质心方面起作用（例如各向同性扩散）；而反对称分量（例如梯度算子 ∇ = [-1,1]）则类似于动量项 pc，通常会引起位移（例如振动或平移）。对于典型的小型离散滤波器，这种位移由反对称分量能量与总滤波器能量之比决定，这类似于相对论粒子的位移由洛伦兹变换中的 β 参数（β = v/c = pc/E，即动量 pc 与总能量 E 的比值）所决定。重复滤波过程导出了高斯尺度空间及涌现的尺度不变特征。这些构造与经典热（扩散）方程具有拉普拉斯驱动的共同结构，并通过标准数学对应关系，进一步关联到薛定谔方程和弗里德曼方程的某些方面，同时涌现出莫尔斯拓扑结构。在三维图像中的实验证明，从有机糖分子、无机硅晶体，到人类与灵长类动物的磁共振成像（MRI）大脑、星系乃至宇宙微波背景（CMB），跨越广泛物理尺度的图像中均存在类似斑点（blob-like）、尺度不变的莫尔斯临界点。

title: VIPER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Veterinary Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models are advancing rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain focused on human tissue, particularly oncology, leaving non-human pathology largely unaddressed. This gap is especially important in toxicologic pathology, where microscopic tissue examination of laboratory animals is a core component of preclinical drug safety assessment. To address it, we introduce VIPER, the first expert-curated benchmark for vision-language model evaluation in toxicologic pathology. VIPER contains 1,251 questions associated with 419 H&E-stained rat histology images across seven organ systems, covering multiple-choice, KPrim, and free-text formats. All questions were curated and validated by board-certified veterinary pathologists. In total, we benchmarked 16 models, including two newly introduced veterinary-pathology models, seven human pathology-specialized models, and seven general-purpose frontier models. The results identify a substantial domain gap between veterinary and human pathology, expose the risk of over-diagnosis of normal tissue in frontier models, and show that domain-specific training remains critical for visually grounded predictions. VIPER data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/viper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了 VIPER，首个针对毒理病理学的视觉-语言模型评测基准，涵盖大鼠组织切片图像与专家验证的问题，揭示了当前模型在兽医与人类病理学之间的领域差距及对正常组织过度诊断的风险。
AI.motivation: 现有病理视觉-语言模型评测基准主要集中于人类组织（尤其是肿瘤学），忽略了非人类病理，特别是在依赖实验动物组织显微检查的毒理病理学领域，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 构建 VIPER 基准：包含419张H&E染色大鼠组织图像、1,251个由认证兽医病理学家审核的问题，覆盖七种器官系统和三种题型；评测16个模型，包括新提出的兽医病理专用模型、人类病理专用模型和通用前沿模型。
AI.result: 评测结果揭示了兽医与人类病理之间存在显著领域差距，前沿模型存在对正常组织过度诊断的风险，并表明领域特定训练对实现准确的视觉基础预测至关重要。
AI.conclusion: VIPER 为毒理病理学中的视觉-语言模型评估提供了首个专业基准，强调了开发面向非人类病理任务的专用模型的重要性。
AI.summary_cn: 病理视觉-语言模型正在迅速发展，但现有的评测基准仍聚焦于人类组织，尤其是肿瘤学领域，而对非人类病理学关注甚少。这一空白在毒理病理学中尤为关键，因为实验动物的显微组织检查是临床前药物安全性评估的核心环节。为解决此问题，我们提出了 VIPER——首个由专家策划的毒理病理学视觉-语言模型评测基准。VIPER 包含419张H&E染色的大鼠组织学图像，涵盖七个器官系统，共1,251个问题，题型包括选择题、KPrim 和自由文本。所有问题均由具有资质的兽医病理学家策划并验证。我们总共评测了16个模型，包括两个新提出的兽医病理专用模型、七个专攻人类病理的模型以及七个通用前沿模型。结果揭示了兽医病理与人类病理之间存在显著的领域差距，暴露了前沿模型对正常组织过度诊断的风险，并表明领域特定训练对于实现基于视觉的准确预测仍然至关重要。VIPER 数据集与评测代码已开源：https://github.com/mahmoodlab/viper。

title: Mapping Woody Vegetation from Multi-Source Imagery and Prediction Fusion for Enhanced Data Efficiency and Accuracy
comment: Published in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Tree cover maps are a fundamental remote sensing product, used to derive ecological insights about the landscape and are essential to change detection, vegetation mapping and fire monitoring programs. However, comprehensive tree cover mapping requires reliable and high-quality imagery, free of cloud and weather defects to ensure accurate model outputs. Deep learning approaches can generate high quality maps with minimal human intervention but require large amounts of human annotated data to be successful. In this work we propose a framework consisting of methods that aim to improve the data efficiency and robustness of deep learning models using data fusion techniques to segment woody vegetation defined as vegetation over the height of 2m across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To improve robustness against varying image quality, we propose an image composition method that normalizes the imagery and removes defects, whilst also minimizing the reliance on individual image quality by proposing a prediction fusion method. The two methods resulted in an error reduction of 38.2% and 53.6% respectively compared to single-source imagery. To address deep learning approaches' limitation of requiring large amounts of data, we apply label transfer to multiple sources of imagery as a form of data augmentation to improve data efficiency. Learning from multiple image sources was shown to be the biggest improvement in performance, resulting in an error reduction between 28.1% to 76.2% across the different validation experiments, whilst reducing the standard deviation of performance across image dates by a factor of 13.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于数据融合的深度学习框架，用于高效、鲁棒地绘制澳大利亚新南威尔士州高于2米的木本植被覆盖图。通过图像合成和预测融合提升对图像质量变化的鲁棒性，并利用标签迁移实现多源影像数据增强，显著减少标注数据需求并提升模型性能。
AI.motivation: 树冠覆盖图是遥感中的基础产品，但高质量制图依赖无云无天气干扰的影像，而深度学习虽能自动产出高质地图，却需大量人工标注数据。因此，亟需提升模型的数据效率与对影像质量变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出包含两种核心方法的框架：1）图像合成方法，用于标准化影像并去除缺陷；2）预测融合方法，降低对单张影像质量的依赖。此外，采用标签迁移技术将标注信息扩展到多源影像，作为数据增强手段以提升数据效率。
AI.result: 图像合成和预测融合分别将误差降低38.2%和53.6%；多源影像学习带来最大性能提升，误差降低28.1%至76.2%，同时将不同日期影像间性能标准差降低13倍。
AI.conclusion: 结合数据融合与标签迁移的深度学习框架能显著提升树冠覆盖制图的精度、鲁棒性和数据效率，减少对高质量单一影像和大量标注数据的依赖。
AI.summary_cn: 树冠覆盖图是一种基础遥感产品，可用于获取关于景观的生态学见解，并对变化检测、植被制图和火灾监测项目至关重要。然而，全面的树冠覆盖制图需要可靠且高质量的影像，且影像必须无云层和天气干扰，以确保模型输出的准确性。深度学习方法能够以最少的人工干预生成高质量地图，但其成功依赖于大量人工标注数据。在本研究中，我们提出一个框架，该框架结合多种方法，利用数据融合技术对澳大利亚新南威尔士州范围内高度超过2米的木本植被进行分割，旨在提高深度学习模型的数据效率和鲁棒性。为增强模型对不同影像质量的鲁棒性，我们提出一种图像合成方法，在标准化影像并去除缺陷的同时，通过预测融合方法最小化对单张影像质量的依赖。这两种方法相较于单一来源影像，分别将误差降低了38.2%和53.6%。为解决深度学习方法对大量数据的需求限制，我们将标签迁移应用于多种影像源，作为一种数据增强形式以提升数据效率。实验表明，从多源影像中学习带来了最大的性能提升，在不同验证实验中误差降低了28.1%至76.2%，同时将不同成像日期下模型性能的标准差降低了13倍。

title: Zero-Shot Video Restoration and Enhancement with Text-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models and Multi-Modal References
summary: Zero-shot image restoration methods with text-to-image latent diffusion models have achieved great success in universal image restoration tasks without training. However, applying them to video restoration will result in severe temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for zero-shot video restoration and enhancement which uses a text-to-image latent diffusion model and multi-modal references. Through the proposed dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling, the inference time can be reduced to nearly 1/3 of the original. The performance and temporal consistency can be also significantly stregthened. By using the proposed texture-aware video token merging, the temporal correlation between frames can be further utilized to improve the temporal consistency. We futher propose the referenced self-attention and referenced token merging to support image reference. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in restoring and enhancing temporally consistent videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的零样本视频修复与增强框架，利用文本到图像潜在扩散模型和多模态参考，在显著提升时间一致性和性能的同时，将推理时间缩短至原来的约1/3。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本图像修复方法在视频修复中会产生严重的时间闪烁问题，亟需一种能保持时间一致性的高效视频修复方案。
AI.method: 提出双提示调谐反转与采样策略以加速推理，并引入纹理感知视频token合并机制增强帧间时间相关性；同时设计参考自注意力与参考token合并模块以支持图像参考。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法在视频修复与增强任务中不仅显著提升了时间一致性，还大幅缩短了推理时间（约为原始方法的1/3）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了零样本视频修复中的时间闪烁问题，在不需额外训练的前提下实现了高质量且时间一致的视频恢复与增强。
AI.summary_cn: 基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本图像修复方法在无需训练的情况下已在通用图像修复任务中取得巨大成功。然而，将其应用于视频修复时会导致严重的时间闪烁问题。本文提出了一种新颖的零样本视频修复与增强框架，该框架结合文本到图像潜在扩散模型与多模态参考。通过所提出的双提示调谐反转与采样策略，推理时间可缩短至原始方法的约三分之一，同时显著增强了性能与时间一致性。借助所提出的纹理感知视频token合并方法，可进一步利用帧间的时间相关性以提升时间一致性。此外，我们还提出了参考自注意力机制与参考token合并方法以支持图像参考。实验结果验证了所提方法在恢复和增强时间一致视频方面的优越性。

title: Learning Woody Clearing With Loss Alignment for Zero-Shot Regrowth and Woody Segmentation
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Detecting woody clearing is vital for managing biodiversity. Deep learning models can detect change in woody vegetation from bitemporal remote sensing imagery, however generated products may not meet end-user specifications due to unaligned loss definitions. Further limitations of deep learning models are the reliance on large datasets which can be difficult to attain for spatially rare and ambiguous events such as regrowth detection. In this work we train a model to detect woody change using bitemporal Sentinel-2 imagery consisting of 7 years' worth of annual imagery across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To align the objective of the model with end-user metrics, we introduce the loss scaling coefficient $α$ which transforms the objective to optimize for specific $F_β$ scores. Introducing $α$ was found to increase precision by 1.85x or recall by 1.12x. We propose input imagery augmentation and generation techniques that allow the woody change detection model to zero-shot transfer to regrowth and woody segmentation tasks. For woody segmentation, image generation techniques using activation maximization with low $α$ values for stability and image generation techniques derived from handcrafted features utilizing a mosaic of clearing patches and artificial trees for contextual grounding were found to outperform prior woody segmentation works of the study area, reducing the overall error by up to 18.2%. For zero-shot woody regrowth, creating pseudo-post and prior images resulted in the model achieving an F1 score of 0.845, creating a foundation for future regrowth detection work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种带损失缩放系数α的深度学习方法，用于从Sentinel-2双时相影像中检测林木变化，并通过图像增强与生成技术实现零样本迁移到再生林和林木分割任务，在新南威尔士州数据上显著提升精度。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习模型在林木清除检测中因损失函数与用户指标不一致而难以满足实际需求，且对稀有或模糊事件（如再生林）缺乏足够标注数据。
AI.method: 使用7年Sentinel-2年度影像训练双时相林木变化检测模型；引入损失缩放系数α以优化特定Fβ分数；设计基于激活最大化和手工特征的图像生成与增强策略，支持零样本迁移到再生林检测和林木分割。
AI.result: 引入α使精确率提升1.85倍或召回率提升1.12倍；林木分割误差最多降低18.2%；零样本再生林检测F1达0.845。
AI.conclusion: 通过调整损失目标和创新图像生成方法，该模型能有效对齐用户需求并泛化至相关但数据稀缺的任务，为林木动态监测提供实用解决方案。
AI.summary_cn: 检测林木清除对于生物多样性管理至关重要。深度学习模型可以从双时相遥感影像中检测林木植被的变化，但由于损失函数定义与最终用户需求不一致，所生成的产品可能无法满足实际应用要求。此外，深度学习模型通常依赖大规模数据集，而对于空间上稀有且模糊的事件（如再生林检测），这类数据往往难以获取。本研究利用澳大利亚新南威尔士州为期7年的年度Sentinel-2影像训练了一个林木变化检测模型。为使模型目标与用户评估指标对齐，我们引入了损失缩放系数α，将优化目标转化为特定的Fβ分数。实验表明，引入α可使精确率提升1.85倍或召回率提升1.12倍。我们还提出了输入影像增强与生成技术，使林木变化检测模型能够零样本迁移到再生林检测和林木分割任务。在林木分割方面，采用低α值的激活最大化进行图像生成以保证稳定性，并结合基于手工特征的图像生成方法（利用清除斑块镶嵌图和人工树木提供上下文基础），其性能优于该区域以往的研究，整体误差最多降低18.2%。在零样本再生林检测中，通过构建伪“后期”和“前期”影像，模型取得了0.845的F1分数，为未来再生林检测工作奠定了基础。

title: Video-FLAIR: Not Whether to Reason, But How
summary: Multimodal queries can require different types of reasoning. Some can be answered via perceptual reasoning, extracting information directly from the visual signal, while others require compositional reasoning that combines observations or deliberative reasoning that evaluates competing hypotheses. However, many existing methods apply a uniform reasoning strategy across queries, leading to unnecessary computation on simple tasks and insufficient reasoning on complex ones. We introduce Video-FLAIR, a training framework that learns to select the appropriate reasoning mode for each query using reinforcement learning. During training, the model generates responses under all three modes for the same prompt, enabling direct comparison. A composite reward compares these responses to favor the most effective one based on correctness, grounding, and cost, while discouraging unsupported or misaligned deliberation. This yields a supervision signal for learning adaptive reasoning without per-query annotations. Video-FLAIR improves accuracy over the Qwen2.5-VL base model by +5.4 on MathVista, +4.8 on Video-Holmes, and +4.8 on Video-MMMU, while reducing average token usage to 95 compared to 417 for always-thinking baselines.

AI.tldr: Video-FLAIR 是一个基于强化学习的训练框架，能为不同视频多模态查询动态选择最合适的推理模式（感知、组合或深思型），在提升准确率的同时显著降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对所有查询采用统一的推理策略，导致简单任务计算冗余、复杂任务推理不足。
AI.method: 提出 Video-FLAIR 框架，在训练时让模型对同一提示同时生成三种推理模式的回答，并通过包含正确性、依据性和成本的复合奖励机制，引导模型学习自适应选择最优推理模式，无需逐查询标注。
AI.result: 相比 Qwen2.5-VL 基础模型，在 MathVista、Video-Holmes 和 Video-MMMU 上分别提升 5.4、4.8 和 4.8 的准确率，平均 token 使用量从 417 降至 95。
AI.conclusion: Video-FLAIR 能有效实现多模态视频问答中的自适应推理，在性能和效率上均优于始终进行深度推理的基线方法。
AI.summary_cn: 多模态查询可能需要不同类型的推理。有些可通过感知推理直接从视觉信号中提取信息来回答，而另一些则需要组合推理（结合多个观察结果）或深思推理（评估相互竞争的假设）。然而，许多现有方法对所有查询采用统一的推理策略，导致在简单任务上产生不必要的计算，而在复杂任务上推理不足。我们提出了 Video-FLAIR，一种利用强化学习为每个查询选择合适推理模式的训练框架。在训练过程中，模型针对同一提示同时以三种推理模式生成回答，从而实现直接比较。一个复合奖励机制根据回答的正确性、依据性和计算成本进行评估，鼓励最有效的推理方式，同时抑制缺乏支持或与任务不符的深思推理。该方法无需逐查询标注即可提供自适应推理的学习监督信号。实验表明，Video-FLAIR 相比 Qwen2.5-VL 基础模型，在 MathVista、Video-Holmes 和 Video-MMMU 数据集上分别提升了 +5.4、+4.8 和 +4.8 的准确率，同时将平均 token 使用量从始终深度推理基线的 417 降至 95。
